verdict.rationale: Cal.com claims a 'generous free tier' and a shareable booking link, a cofounder says Calendly-PRO features are free, and one hands-on user runs a recruiter booking calendar on the free tier. That same user reports the free tier dropped to 1 active event type after a trial, a real limit on individual scheduling. missing for 10: first-party documentation of what the free plan includes (event-type limits, booking-link features), independent confirmation beyond one anecdote, and clarity on post-trial restrictions.

support.subject: As a founder, the free tier covers real individual scheduling — a usable booking link without a paid plan

citations.quote: Share a booking link, connect your calendars, and let people pick a time without the back-and-forth.
everything that is PRO on calendly is free on cal.com
it works well enough for their recruiter booking calendar
